name: @extas/orders
description: The order core (S05, CN-022): the order state machine with its commands as the one order service (PR 138), the timeline, cancellation with reason codes and refund requests (PR 144), the duplicate-order defence and its review queue (PR 145), notes and internal flags (PR 147), and hold and release (PR 153). PR 563: the call queue; PR 127: "Add to this parcel" (a line added before booking, priced by @extas/rules). No money moves here. PR 605: deliveryTarget — who and where a parcel goes to (a gift's receiver), for the sticker and the booking.
